description: This Java source file defines a Spring REST controller for managing device profiles in the Thingsboard platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and setting default device profiles, as well as fetching related data such as time series keys and attribute keys. The class is annotated with Spring and custom annotations, and interacts with various services to perform its operations.

classes.name: DeviceProfileController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for managing device profiles, providing endpoints for CRUD operations, default setting, and data retrieval related to device profiles.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileById
methods.description: Fetches a device profile by its ID, optionally inlining images.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves device profile info by ID.

methods.name: getDefaultDeviceProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the default device profile info.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileTimeseriesKeys
methods.description: Gets unique time series keys used by devices of a specified profile.

methods.name: getAttributesKeys
methods.description: Gets unique attribute keys used by devices of a specified profile.

methods.name: saveDeviceProfile
methods.description: Creates or updates a device profile.

methods.name: deleteDeviceProfile
methods.description: Deletes a device profile by ID.

methods.name: setDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Sets a device profile as the default within a tenant.

methods.name: getDeviceProfiles
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of device profiles.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileInfos
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of device profile info objects.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileNames
methods.description: Returns a list of unique device profile names.

methods.name: getDeviceProfileInfosByIdsV1
methods.description: Retrieves device profile info objects by their UUIDs (internal use).

methods.name: getDeviceProfileInfosByIds
methods.description: Retrieves device profile info objects by their UUIDs.
